_comment: Copy to config.local.json (git-ignored) and fill in. Every field can also come from env vars (SONARR_HOST, SONARR_PORT, SONARR_HTTPS, SONARR_API_KEY, SONARR_URL_BASE, SONARR_VERIFY_SSL, SONARR_TIMEOUT), which override the file. Create the API key in Sonarr under Settings > General > Security > API Key (grants full admin). host/port/url_base together form the base URL; if Sonarr is at http://nas:8989/sonarr use url_base="/sonarr". Secrets normally come from 1Password (Homelab vault item 'Sonarr API Key (NAS-Host)').
